lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I've been working on this idea for six months. If I get two minutes with the right person—

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Macal, relax. Let me handle the talking. You just... stand there and look interested.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Stand there? This is my pitch, Tarek. I mean—it was my pitch.
lines.direction: struggling to stay calm, correcting himself

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Was. Exactly. Watch and learn, habibi.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Hey. I heard that. Don't let him do this to you.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I can't just stand here, Nour. Not again.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا أَهْلًا! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَإِنْتَ فِي Yalla Fluent. النَّهَارْدَه مَعَانَا حَاجَة كِبِيرَة... ماكال رَايِح حَفْلَة تَوَاصُل فِي غُرْفَة دُبَيّ، وَعَايِز يِدْخُل يِتَكَلِّم مَعَ نَاس، وَيِعَرَّف فِكْرِتُه!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَسْ فِي مُشْكِلَة... صَاحْبُه طَارِق عَايِز يِخُد الفِكْرَة لِنَفْسُه، وَيِسِيب ماكال وَاقِف زَي التِّمْثَالْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: النَّهَارْدَه هِنِتْعَلِّم تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات حَيَاتِيَّة... لَمَّا تِعَايِز تِدْخُل عَلَى جَمَاعَة، تِقُول: mind if I join you? وَلَمَّا تِعَايِز تِفْتَح كَلَام صَغِير، تِقُول: so how do you know the host? وَلَمَّا تِخَلِّص كَلَام مَعَ حَد، تِقُول: I'll follow up with you.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا بِنَا... نِسْمَع ماكال بِيِتْكَلِّم! وَرَكِّز مَعَايَا كُوَيِّس، لَأَنَّ الإِنْجِلِيزِي بِتِتْعَلَّم بِالحَيَاة، مِش بِالحِفْظ!

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Look, there's the program manager from the fellowship. She's right there by the coffee stand.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I see her. But every time I walk up to a group, my brain just... freezes. Like I forget every word I know.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Then don't walk up to her. Start with the group next to her. Just ease in. Small talk first.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Okay, I can do that. Excuse me—mind if I join you?

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Of course, please. Try the karak. Best in the whole building, I promise you.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thanks. So, how do you know the host here? This is my first time at one of these events.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Everyone at the Chamber knows him. I serve coffee, he talks. But you—you look like you have something to say tonight.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I do, actually. I've been working on a platform idea for small businesses. I mean, local shops, people like you. I live here since two years, and I keep seeing the same problem.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Sorry, I couldn't help overhearing. A platform for small businesses? That's exactly what the fellowship panel is looking for.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Really? Then I'd love to share it with you. Can I follow up with you after the panel? Maybe over email?

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Please do. Here's my card. And if Tarek asks—he's been talking about the same idea all evening. I'd rather hear it from you.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you. I'll follow up with you tomorrow morning. Nour—did you hear that? She wants to hear it from me.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَقَفْنَا مَع ماكال وَهُوَّ بِيِدْخُل عَلَى جَمَاعَة... وِقَال: mind if I join you? يَعْنِي: تِسْمَح لِي أَقْعَد مَعَاكُم؟ دِي أَدَب وَتَوْفِير... بِتَخَلِّي النَّاسْ تِرَحِّب بِيك، وَمِش بِتَحِسْ إِنَّك غَرِيب!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَبَعْدِين بِيِفْتَح كَلَام صَغِير، وِقَال: so how do you know the host? يَعْنِي: إِنْتَ تِعْرَف المُضِيف إِزَّاي؟ السُّؤَال دَه سِحْر... لَأَنُّه بِيِخَلِّي الطَّرَف التَّانِي يِتْكَلَّم عَنْ نَفْسُه، وَإِنْتَ تِرْتَاح!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَفِي الآخِر، عَايِز يِخَلِّص كَلَام مَع الإِنْتَرْفيُوَر، فَقَال: I'll follow up with you! يَعْنِي: هَتَابِع مَعَاك، هَكَلِّمَك تَانِي عَن الفِكْرَة. دِي الجُمْلَة الذَّهَبِيَّة بَعْد أَي لِقَاء، لَأَنُّهَا بِتَحْفَظ التَّوَاصُل... مِش بِتَسِيبُه يِضِيع!
lines.direction: emphasis on the golden phrase, warm

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَسْ خُد بَالَك مِن غَلْطَة ماكال الصَّغِيرَة... قَال: I live here since two years. العَرَبِي بِيِقُول: أَنَا عَايِش هِنَا مِن سَنَتَيْن. فَإِحْنَا بِنِقْلِب حَرْفِيًّا، وَنِسْتَخْدِم since... بَسْ الإِنْجِلِيزِي مَا بِيِقُولْهَاش كِدَه!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: الصَّح: I've lived here for two years. بِنِسْتَخْدِم for مَعَ المُدَّة، وَالمَاضِي الْمُسْتَمِرّ... I've lived. تِفْتَكِر: for المدة، وsince بَدَايَة الوَقْت. مِثَال تَانِي: I've worked there for six months. وَالغَلْطَة دِي بِنَعْمِلْهَا كُلَّنَا، فَمَا تِخَافْش!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا نِكَمِّل... نُصِّ الحَفْلَة فَاضِل، وَطَارِق لِسَّه بِيِلْعَب لُعْبَتُه!
lines.direction: bright, building suspense to next scene

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: That was smooth, Macal. You didn't freeze once. I was watching from the corner.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Honestly? My hands were shaking. But the words came out. I mean, I've practiced that small talk so many times in my head.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Well, practice paid off. She gave you her card. That never happens at these things.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I know. I'm still not sure it's real. I'll send her the pitch tonight before I lose my nerve.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Macal. Good to see you here. I hear you've been talking to the fellowship people. Interesting. I've pitched them the same platform idea, for two years.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I've worked on my version for two years too, Tarek. Since I moved here. So let's see what the panel decides.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Sure. May the best man win. Oh, and Macal? Next time, maybe read the room first.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Don't listen to him. He does that to everyone. Come on, let's get some air.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Macal, wait, before you go. I just spoke to Nour's manager. She runs the Rising Voices program. She wants you to pitch at the next round.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: She wants me? On the stage? In front of the panel?

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: In front of everyone. Three minutes. And Macal, Tarek is also on that list.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا نِلَخِّص بِسُرْعَة... دَخَلْت عَلَى جَمَاعَة بِأَدَب: mind if I join you? وَفَتَحْت كَلَام صَغِير: so how do you know the host? وَخَلَّصْت بِذَكَاء: I'll follow up with you! تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَات، وَمَعَاهُم تِقْدِر تِدْخُل أَي حَفْلَة!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَلَا تِنْسَى التَّصْحِيح... مِش I live here since two years، لَأ! قُول: I've lived here for two years. for مَعَ المُدَّة، و since مَعَ البِدَايَة، وَخَلَاص!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الحَلْقَة... I'll follow up with you. احْفَظْهَا، وَقُولْهَا بَعْد كُل لِقَاء... بِتَخَلِّي التَّوَاصُل عَايِش!
lines.direction: proud, encouraging, slow on the key phrase

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَعَالَى عَلَى تِلِجْرَام... اكْتُب لِي الجُمْلَة دِي فِي تَعْلِيق، وَاشْتَرِك فِي البُودْكَاسْت، عَشَان تِتْكَلِّم مَعَانَا كُل أُسْبُوع!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالحَلْقَة الجَايَة... ماكال هَيِطْلَع عَلَى الْمَسْرَح، أَمَام اللَّجْنَة، وَطَارِق كَمَان! ثَلَاث دَقَايِق... يَا تِرْبَح، يَا تِتْعَلِّم. مَا تِفَوِّتْهَاش!
lines.direction: suspenseful tease, rising energy at the end
